title: A second independent route into the roster
summary: Open Android through sequential authorised roster reads while retaining the protected snapshot and fallback for other devices.
changes: Android now uses sequential authorised roster reads instead of the one-request transport that remains pending on the affected Samsung browser.
Each compatibility read and the protected snapshot have application-level deadlines that do not depend on the browser completing an abort event.
Try again can no longer wait indefinitely for the abandoned startup promise.
No changes to roster, staffing, allocation, Pager, Reliever, five-nurse, realtime, privacy, database schema or write rules.
